name: What is the process for a kitchen layout redesign with Simply Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a kitchen layout redesign with Simply Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our kitchen layout redesign process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we develop preliminary designs and floor plans, incorporating your feedback until a final design is approved. We then assist with material selections and secure necessary permits. Construction starts with demolition, followed by structural changes, utility rough-ins, and installation of cabinets, countertops, and appliances. The project concludes with finishing touches and a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, design, material selection, permitting, construction (demolition, rough-ins, installation), and a final walkthrough.
